verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is an open-source, dependency-free C/C++ project that can be built from source, downloaded as prebuilt binaries, or run via Docker, and includes its own server/web UI (`llama serve`) for local self-hosting across CPU/GPU/Apple Silicon. Extensive community evidence confirms users successfully self-hosting it on personal machines (M1 Macs, desktop CPUs, GPUs) for local inference.
